label: Explain

notes.note: T1: overlay checked; page curves, doubled lower edge, spine and rays match
Passed the independent review (creative director) on first reading

corrections.what: Mirrored the book about the spine, x 92.5, using one curve per edge type for both halves
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The spine measures x 92.65, the page-block sides centre on 92.57 and the cover sides on 92.5; circle fits to the left and right edges agree within 1.3 px of radius.

corrections.what: Drew each page edge as one cubic curve fitted to both halves: flat near the outer corner, bowing down into the valley (top edges meet the spine at y 69, inner bottom edges at 124.5, outer cover edges at the bottom point 133.6)
corrections.why: The sheet's edges are not circular arcs: they run level for the first 5 px from each corner and then curve, so a circle misfits by up to 1 px at the corners. The cubic fits within 0.05 to 0.15 px rms.

corrections.what: Centred the three rays on the spine: the diagonals move 0.56 px right and the vertical ray 0.3 px right
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The rays centre on x 91.93 to 92.2 on both sheets while the book centres on 92.5.

corrections.what: Moved the cover's outer sides 0.05 px in and its lower corners 0.05 px up (x 11.3 and 173.7, y 122.3)
corrections.why: At the measured 11.25, 173.75 and 122.25 the stroke edges fell exactly on pixel midlines, so the 1x bake check flipped edge pixels (IoU 0.987); the nudge is invisible and restores it to 1.0.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set line weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The rays measure 5.6 to 5.9 px; the book 4.9 to 5.9 px.

source_notes: Pillar mark (DR-04). Kept: the hollow page blocks with no text; the doubled lower edge (page blocks and cover); the cover's short top stubs stepping out from the page-block sides at y 57; square outer corners with round joins; the spine running from the valley to the cover's bottom point; three separate rays, the vertical one longer, the diagonals at 56 deg. Red is the three rays only; both sheets agree.
